tools.description: Apply independent updates in a bounded SQLite transaction
tools.name: bulk_update_todos

parentId.description: Optional parent Todo ID for a subtask

tools.description: Queue a durable asynchronous Todo import
tools.name: import_todos

tools.description: Move or complete a todo. Always call this tool when a user asks to move or complete a todo; do not ask a manual follow-up first. If moving a parent to done with incomplete subtasks, this tool returns input_required with a signed requestState and options. Present that server response to the user, then retry this same tool with their choice and requestState.
tools.name: move_todo

tools.description: Request cancellation of an import task
tools.name: tasks_cancel
